advanced_calculations.name: PY Parameter DNF
advanced_calculations.formula:
IF SUM([PY Sales (copy)_1064819864315519014]) < 0 THEN '-' ELSE '' END
+
IF [Parameters].[Top N Selection (copy)_1064819864313110563] < 3 THEN '$' ELSE '' END
+
STR(INT(ROUND(ABS(SUM([PY Sales (copy)_1064819864315519014]))/POWER(1000, INT(LOG(ROUND(ABS(SUM([PY Sales (copy)_1064819864315519014]))/10, 0)*10, 1000))), 1)))
+
IF (ROUND(ABS(SUM([PY Sales (copy)_1064819864315519014]))/POWER(1000, INT(LOG(ABS(SUM([PY Sales (copy)_1064819864315519014])), 1000))), 1)*10)%10 = 0 THEN ''
ELSE '.' + STR((ROUND(ABS(SUM([PY Sales (copy)_1064819864315519014]))/POWER(1000, INT(LOG(ABS(SUM([PY Sales (copy)_1064819864315519014])), 1000))),1)*10)%10)
END
+
CASE INT(LOG(ROUND(ABS(SUM([PY Sales (copy)_1064819864315519014]))/10,0)*10,1000))
WHEN 1 THEN 'K'
WHEN 2 THEN 'M'
WHEN 3 THEN 'B'
WHEN 4 THEN 'T'
ELSE ''
END
